faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Lakshadweep Administration Computer Programmer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Computer Programmer post is 06 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this deadline.

faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, B.Sc. Computer Science, B.Sc. Information Technology (IT), Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA), or an equivalent degree in Computer.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Computer Programmer position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Computer Programmer post in the Lakshadweep Administration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Computer Programmer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 23,000 per month.

faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.
